scripts.start: concurrently --prefix "{time} {name} †" -k -t "HH:mm" -n "FE,BE" -c "green.bold,red.bold" "yarn workspace caroline-fe start" "yarn workspace caroline-be start"
scripts.test: yarn test:types && yarn test:unit && echo "✅ All tests passed! Run 'yarn test:smoke' to test a live server."
scripts.start:docker: PUBLISH_ADDR=0.0.0.0 API_URL=http://localhost:4021/api docker compose --profile dev up --build
scripts.prod:docker: docker network create edge >/dev/null 2>&1; BUILD_TARGET=prod BACKEND_CMD="bun ./dist/index.js" docker compose --profile prod up --build --detach
